description:
FILED s521c (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) from the #3432 one-file acceptance run of IO-Compress t/004gziphdr.t: past eq_set (row 450) the file now runs to row 463 and stops at line 343, a DROPPED statement:
    PCL: statement not supported at t/004gziphdr.t line 343: my @tests = ( [ sub{ "abc" } => ...], ..., [ [ { 'abc', 1 } ] => ...], ... ) -- Bug. Fell through. Missing case: ['Statement::Compound< { 'abc', 1 }>', ...]

CAUSE: PPI bug §5 (docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md: `{ LITERAL , ... }` -- an anon hash -- is lexed as a Block).  PCL's workaround (`_bare_block_is_anon_hash`, Pl/Parser.pm) covers a STATEMENT-level Compound; inside a constructor (`[ [ { 'abc', 1 } ] ]`) the Block reaches the expression compiler unrepaired.

REPRO (probed, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL on 68aeebf5 + s521c, scratch/s521c/pr/anonh.pl):
    my @t = ( [ [ { 'abc', 1 } ] => "x" ], [ 2 => "y" ] );
    print ref($t[0][0][0]), " $t[0][0][0]{abc} $t[1][1]\n";
perl: HASH 1 y      PCL: "  y" -- a SILENT WRONG in this spelling (the hash is lost), a statement drop in 004gziphdr.t's.
Fix at the PPI-repair layer (one predicate with the statement-level workaround, rule 11).
REACH: IO-Compress 004gziphdr.t rows 464-919 (456 rows never produced).


=== DONE (s539c) ===
The FILED shape ([ [ { 'abc', 1 } ] => ...]) was already lexed right on PCL's PPI branch (s527c §5 / group AK; probes h1-h14 SAME on the base).  The file stopped two lines further, on 004gziphdr.t line 357's `[ { \1 , "abc" } => ...]`: the first { of a statement inside a Structure::Constructor went to the statement-start look-ahead, which knows a hash only by a literal and a comma.  PPI §67, group AZ (pcl-s539c c1189f77 TODO tests / af11a2c3 fix): _curly returns a Constructor there -- perl expects a term after [ (toke.c yyl_leftcurly: XTERM makes HASHBRACK).  PCL needed nothing: _bare_block_is_anon_hash was already deleted (s527c); PExpr::_block_is_hash_constructor is the map / grep body rule and stays.
Probes h15-h19 (scratch/s539c/p/h): base DIFF -- drops and two SILENT WRONGs ([ { $x, 1 } ], [ { %h } ] held no hash) -> tree SAME.  Guard Pl/t/ppi-token-rows-01.t §67 row.
ACCEPTANCE: IO-Compress t/004gziphdr.t one-file run 463 of 919 rc 255 -> 919/0 of 919 rc 0 (scratch/s539c/board1.log); the *PLAN* row left baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit.
